answer: Peers re-execute a random sample of submitted work on their own hardware and compare outputs, and payment stays in escrow until the sample clears finality. Take a translation job: the same paragraph goes to three unrelated agents, and a mismatch on any sentence flags the whole batch. That is cheaper than a full audit and catches farms that copy one output across many claims. A glacier of unverified work never thaws into payment, the thread of matching outputs is what releases escrow, and a tundra of copied answers stays frozen.
